description: This file contains unit test definitions and mock class implementation for the UnitConversionManager, including static unit and category definitions, and a mock class for unit conversion operations used in testing.

classes.name: UnitConverterMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IUnitConverter interface for testing purposes, providing stub methods and internal state tracking.

methods.name: UnitConverterMock
methods.description: Constructor for the mock unit converter class.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the mock converter, typically setting up internal state.

methods.name: GetCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of categories available in the mock converter.

methods.name: SetCurrentCategory
methods.description: Sets the current category for conversion.

methods.name: SetCurrentUnitTypes
methods.description: Sets the units to be used for conversion.

methods.name: SwitchActive
methods.description: Switches the active state based on a string value.

methods.name: IsSwitchedActive
methods.description: Returns whether the converter is in an active switched state.

methods.name: SaveUserPreferences
methods.description: Saves user preferences to a string.

methods.name: RestoreUserPreferences
methods.description: Restores user preferences from a string.

methods.name: SendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the converter.

methods.name: SetViewModelCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for the view model.

methods.name: ResetCategoriesAndRatios
methods.description: Resets categories and ratios to default.

methods.name: RefreshCurrencyRatios
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes currency ratios, returning success status and message.
